# Examples: context compression

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_examples_gallery.py; edit the examples, not this. -->

Shrink what each model call sends. Back to the [Examples gallery](../examples.md). Files here: 12.

| File | Shows | Install | Run | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `examples/compression_agent_framework.py` | Compress what Microsoft Agent Framework sends on every model call, with chat middleware. | `pip install "agent-adapter[agent-framework]"` | import only | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_backend.py` | No agent framework: a script and a FastAPI route call your model with compression on. | `pip install agent-adapter`; optional: `pip install fastapi` | `python examples/compression_backend.py` | [Compress a long context](../how-to/compress-long-context.md) |
| `examples/compression_camel.py` | Compress the CAMEL `ChatAgent` memory records it builds each model call's context from. | `pip install "agent-adapter[camel]"` | import only | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_crewai.py` | Compress a CrewAI agent's messages before each LLM call; they are OpenAI chat dicts. | `pip install agent-adapter` | import only | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_dspy.py` | Compress the chat messages DSPy builds for each LM call, with an adapter subclass. | `pip install "agent-adapter[dspy]"` | import only | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_framework_hooks.py` | Compress what Pydantic AI, Agno, Strands, smolagents, AutoGen and AG2 send to the model. | `pip install agent-adapter`; optional: `pip install "agent-adapter[ag2,agno,autogen,pydantic-ai,smolagents,strands]"` | `python examples/compression_framework_hooks.py` | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_frameworks.py` | Compress a framework's own message list where it calls the model; no framework installed. | `pip install agent-adapter` | `python examples/compression_frameworks.py` | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_langchain.py` | LangChain alone: compress the message list before `model.invoke`; no LangGraph needed. | `pip install "agent-adapter[langchain]"` | `python examples/compression_langchain.py` | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_langgraph.py` | LangGraph: compress `state["messages"]` in your agent node, before the model. | `pip install "agent-adapter[langgraph]"` | `python examples/compression_langgraph.py` | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_llamaindex.py` | Compress a LlamaIndex `ChatMessage` list before the LLM call; the list keeps its type. | `pip install "agent-adapter[llamaindex]"` | import only | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
| `examples/compression_one_call.py` | One model call, four policies: trim only, cut only, summarise only, and all combined. | `pip install agent-adapter` | `python examples/compression_one_call.py` | [Compress a long context](../how-to/compress-long-context.md) |
| `examples/compression_semantic_kernel.py` | Compress a Semantic Kernel `ChatHistory` copy before the chat service call. | `pip install "agent-adapter[semantic-kernel]"` | import only | [Compression by framework](../integrations/compression-by-framework.md) |
